whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Kedia Orthodontics & Dental,

I noticed your clinic has strong 4.6★ reviews in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new patient appointment inquiries.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, dental services, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/kedia

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Kedia Orthodontics & Dental, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dental clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and mobile-first speed for patients searching on New Dak Bunglow Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
